text:
alex: Quick follow-up on the proxy's graceful stream resume signals — want to align on what we emit and what we sample for observability.

maria: yes please. are we still planning to attach resume checkpoints to trailers only? that felt brittle across some clients.

raj: I think trailers are fine for end-of-stream, but midstream checkpoints need headers or a side-channel. trailers don't survive some intermediaries.

alex: agreed — proposal: emit short resume markers in a stable header (x-resume-token) every N tokens, and emit a detailed checkpoint event to trace/log ingestion (sampled).

sophie: +1 for header markers. question: how big is the token->header churn? we must keep header size tiny to avoid MTU issues.

maria: we can encode a compact token: 12 bytes base64-ish (nonce + seq). small and opaque. only used for resuming a specific session.

raj: observability side: trace spans should include resume-seq and resume-reason (preempt, retry, failover). sample rate should be low for high-volume routes. maybe 1% by default.

alex: thinking defaults: header checkpoint interval = 512 tokens, header token = 16 chars base64, trace sampling = 1% per route, but bump to 10% on error states.

maria: fallback policy: if header absent but trailer present, attempt resume using trailer token. if neither, no resume. document this behaviour.

ops-bot: deploy: canary edge release v0.12.3 includes resume-header flag (off by default). monitoring alert resume-token-drop-rate > 0.5% for 5m.

sophie: operational question — does attaching headers affect cache keys for CDNs or upstreams? we must strip before caching. add strip rule in frontdoor.

raj: agree. implement strip on ingress path before any cache key computation. also add metric: resume-token-stripped_count.

alex: nice. follow-ups: 1) PR with header encoder/decoder + compact format 2) tracing changes + sampling config 3) ops runbook text for resume fallbacks 4) add canary flag. i'll open the RFC followup doc and assign owners.

maria: i'll take runbook + canary alerting.

sophie: i'll add the strip rule and validate cache tests.

raj: i'll do tracer + metric patches.

alex: thanks all. quick example of the header payload sketch:

```
X-Resume-Token: v1:AB12cD3eF4g5H6i7
// format = v<ver>:<12-16 char opaque id>
```

alex: keeping this thread for the short sync notes; will link RFC when PRs open. :thumbsup:
